description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than **0** and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用[DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID.
